name: krysmalskipl
description: Claude Code mods by Jakub Krysmalski, built for SEO and content work: lines above the prompt and checks on what Claude writes.

plugins.name: openrouter-balance
plugins.description: Your OpenRouter credit above the prompt: the balance with a gauge, today's spend and where the money mostly went. /openrouter-balance shows the breakdown.

plugins.name: meta-lint
plugins.description: SEO basics of the page or post Claude just edited, above the prompt: title and meta description length, H1 count, images without alt, word count. /meta-lint shows the details and a search snippet preview.

plugins.name: link-check
plugins.description: Checks the external links Claude adds to pages, posts and templates. Broken ones go back to Claude so it can fix them, and show above the prompt. /links lists them or checks a whole file.
